name: Fellow Opus
details: Electric conical burr grinder for espresso to cold brew.

notes.turkish: Not fine enough for Turkish coffee.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 1–2.5, moka pot 2.5–5.5, AeroPress 2–8.75, V60 3–6, filter coffee machine 2–8, French press 6–11, cold brew 7.25–11. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
